summary: Sporting News guide to the 2023/24 Carabao Cup (EFL League Cup), covering format, round dates, the semifinal draw, results for every round from the first round to the quarterfinals, and TV/streaming options in the UK, USA, Canada and Australia. Liverpool v Fulham and Middlesbrough v Chelsea are the semifinal pairings, with the final at Wembley on Feb. 25, 2024. It also explains the competition's history and its Thai sponsor Carabao.
one_line: Complete guide to the 2023/24 Carabao Cup: format, draws, round-by-round results, semifinal pairings, final date, broadcasters and the origin of the sponsor name.
key_facts: The 2023/24 Carabao Cup is the 64th edition of the League Cup and began on August 8, 2023.
The final is on Sunday, February 25, 2024 at Wembley Stadium in London.
Manchester United are the holders after beating Newcastle United in the 2023 final, but Newcastle beat them 3-0 in round four on Nov. 1.
The winner earns a place in the 2024/25 UEFA Conference League playoffs.
All 92 clubs from the top four English tiers take part; 12 Premier League clubs not in Europe join in round two and the other eight in round three.
There is no extra time up to and including the quarterfinals; level matches go straight to penalties after 90 minutes. Extra time applies to the semifinal second legs (no away goals) and the final.
Semifinals are two-legged: Middlesbrough vs. Chelsea and Liverpool vs. Fulham, with first legs in the week of Jan. 8, 2024 and second legs in the week of Jan. 22, 2024.
The semifinal draw was held at Anfield after Liverpool beat West Ham 5-1 in the quarterfinals.
Quarterfinal results: Everton 1-1 Fulham (Fulham won 7-6 on penalties), Chelsea 1-1 Newcastle (Chelsea won 4-2 on penalties), Port Vale 0-3 Middlesbrough, Liverpool 5-1 West Ham.
League Two Mansfield Town were the lowest-ranked team left in round four, when they lost 1-0 to League One Port Vale.
In round three, Championship side Ipswich Town beat Premier League Wolves 3-2 and League One Exeter City beat Luton Town 1-0.
In round two, Fulham beat Tottenham 5-3 on penalties and Wrexham lost to Bradford City 4-3 on penalties.
Sky Sports is the exclusive UK broadcaster; ESPN+ in the USA, DAZN in Canada, and beIN Sports in Australia.
Thai energy drink company Carabao has held title rights since the 2017/18 edition, following earlier sponsors Coca-Cola, Worthington's and Carling.
